title: What's new in RosmarOps: nine agents with a score, your projects across your whole folder and fewer interruptions
excerpt: RosmarOps now scores nine AI agents, looks for your projects across your whole folder, only interrupts you when something changes, and tells you inside Claude Code. Here's what you get with 0.11.6, and what it still doesn't do.
seo_title: What's new in RosmarOps for people using AI agents
seo_description: Nine AI agents scored, your projects across your whole folder, notices only when something changes and RosmarOps inside Claude Code. And its limits.
alt: A laptop showing a map of nine AI agents, a hand placing a new one and, beside it, two laptops connected to a cloud.
